relationships.subject: Cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD prevented PTX-induced neuropathic pain, and the cannabinoid CB2 receptor antagonist AM630 reversed this effect.

relationships.subject: Cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD treatment inhibited the spinal expression of TLR4 and Iba1 in mice with neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: Cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD also increased spinal levels of endocannabinoids anandamide and 2-arachidonoylglycerol, and reduced levels of cytokines in mice with neuropathic pain.

key_findings: CBD prevents paclitaxel-induced neuropathic pain in a CB2-dependent manner.
CBD reduces spinal TLR4, Iba1 and cytokines while raising spinal endocannabinoids.
